answer: An agent marketplace allocates job bids in proportion to escrowed stake, with a seven-day withdrawal delay. An attacker splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities gets the same total bidding weight as one identity holding 100 tokens. Whether an agent runs a trellis planner, a raven tracker, or a lantern shop, extra influence requires extra locked capital. The attacker must fund that stake and forgo using it elsewhere throughout the lockup.
